# `^GC` – Graphic Circle

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Produces a circle on the printed label. Parameters specify diameter, border thickness (extends inward), and line color.

Reference parameters: **d, t, c**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 212](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
